versions.changelog:
- Documentation updated; SKILL.md was changed.
- No changes to features or functionality.
- Version number remains at 1.2.0.

Version 1.2.0 introduces post-level engagement scoring, auto-rewrite for low-quality posts, and adaptive content mix.

- Each post now scored 0–100 on hook strength, platform fit, specificity, and CTA clarity; low scorers are auto-rewritten for quality (max 2 passes)
- New `--min-score` flag sets quality threshold for auto-rewrite gate
- Supports `--past-results` for adaptive theme weighting based on previous engagement data
- New `--tracker` outputs a blank engagement tracking template for Notion/Sheets
- Updated description, input/output contract, and usage to reflect smarter, adaptive calendar generation

content-calendar-pro v1.0.1

- Added main generation script (`generate_calendar.py`) enabling actual calendar creation from the command line.
- Added quality assurance and testing documentation (`qa-skill.md`).
- Updated documentation in `SKILL.md` to reflect command-line usage and input/output options.
- Skill now provides the core calendar generation functionality as described.

Initial release of content-calendar-pro

- Generate 7-day (free) or 30-day (premium) social media content calendars for any niche/audience.
- Outputs structured JSON and human-readable formats, with hooks, body copy, CTAs, and hashtags per post.
- Platform-aware: adapts formatting and tone for LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Facebook, and Instagram.
- Free tier: 7-day calendar per platform; 30-day, multi-platform, A/B hook variants, and CSV export in premium (API key required).
- Includes compliance checker and weekly theme options.
- Supports automated variety, five-pillar content mix, and scheduling-ready exports.
